tools.name: search_airports
tools.description: Find airport IATA codes by city, airport name, metro area, or code.

tools.name: search_flights
tools.description: Search one-way or round-trip flight prices between two IATA airport codes. Returns complete booking_options with leg coverage and prices when known. Choose one link per group; multiple groups require separate bookings. booking_url is also included when one booking covers the whole itinerary.

tools.name: search_cheapest_dates
tools.description: Compare the lowest one-way or round-trip fare for each departure date across up to 31 dates. Prices are not bookable; search the chosen date with search_flights.
